subject.title: [Bug]: Session stuck in permanent busy state after mid-turn gateway restart — no auto-recovery, only /new or /reset clears it

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the focused canonical bug for mid-turn gateway restart recovery while consolidating the open delivery and stale-lane fix PRs?
rationale: Automation should not choose between overlapping conflicting recovery PRs or close the issue while the discussion still contains current-release field evidence that recovery can start but fail before final delivery.

options.title: Keep focused and consolidate fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, use it as the focused proof target, and review or replace the related open recovery/delivery PRs before closure.

options.title: Move remaining scope to the broad tracker
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly decide the unique Telegram field evidence is fully captured by `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425`.

options.title: Queue a fresh repair later
options.body: Start a new repair only after maintainers decide the existing open PRs are not viable or need replacement.

recommendation.title: Keep focused and consolidate fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, use it as the focused proof target, and review or replace the related open recovery/delivery PRs before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart recovery seam work makes this the best available routing owner for deciding how to consolidate the overlapping recovery paths.
